nodes.label: Feature-First Layered Architecture
nodes.rationale: Organize by business feature (Auth, POS, Inventory) instead of technical layer so desktop/tablet POS features stay self-contained; each feature carries its own domain/data/presentation slices while cross-cutting infra lives in core/. Development is staged across 8 sequential phases.

nodes.label: State Management Pillar (Riverpod)
nodes.rationale: AsyncNotifier is preferred for asynchronous state (database fetching, hardware status) because loading/error/data are modeled explicitly; plain Providers cover reactive UI updates and dependency injection.
nodes.community_name: Riverpod Architecture Decision (provider type per concern)

nodes.label: Navigation Pillar (GoRouter routerProvider)
nodes.rationale: A single central routerProvider in lib/app.dart owns routing so onboarding redirect logic and global keyboard shortcuts for power users have one place to live.

nodes.label: Dual Data Layer (Drift + Hive)
nodes.rationale: Drift is the single source of truth for transactions, products and inventory because relational integrity matters for money; Hive holds configuration, branding, printer settings and held-order snapshots where a KV store is cheaper than a table.

nodes.label: Data Flow (UI to Notifier to DAO to Stream)
nodes.rationale: Reactivity is achieved by letting Drift streams and ref.watch push changes back to the UI rather than manual refresh calls, so persistence and rendering never drift apart.
nodes.norm_label: data flow (ui to notifier to dao to stream)
nodes.community_name: Riverpod Architecture Decision (provider type per concern)

nodes.label: Package-Imports-Only Rule
nodes.rationale: Always use package:pos_app/... imports and avoid relative imports so files can be moved between feature folders without rewriting import graphs.

nodes.label: build_runner Code Generation Workflow
nodes.rationale: Many files depend on drift and riverpod_generator output, so `dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` is the canonical regeneration command.

nodes.label: No Hardcoded Colors (AppTheme / colorScheme)
nodes.rationale: Colors must come from Theme.of(context).colorScheme or AppTheme extensions so brand-kit and day/night theming can be swapped globally without touching widgets.

nodes.label: PrintingService Abstraction
nodes.rationale: Print logic is funneled through a single PrintingService so hardware/driver churn stays out of feature code.

nodes.label: heathen_printer_plus (documented printer package)
nodes.rationale: Documented as the critical Bluetooth/Network thermal printer dependency, but pubspec.yaml actually declares flutter_thermal_printer — the audit appears stale on this point.

nodes.label: google_fonts listed as Utility dependency
nodes.rationale: Listed here as a utility package, yet CLAUDE.md explicitly bans it because it fetches font files at runtime; bundled JetBrainsMono assets are the sanctioned replacement.

nodes.label: Zero External APIs / Services
nodes.rationale: No payment processor, no email/SMS gateway, no external APIs — the app operates fully offline and hands off messaging to external apps via URL launching (WhatsApp, Email).

nodes.label: Local-Only Data Storage (Drift file + Hive + path_provider)

nodes.label: No Error Tracking, Analytics, or CI Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Observability is stdout debug logs only, and no .github/workflows CI was detected — consistent with the no-telemetry offline mandate.

nodes.label: Platform Requirements (Android API 21+, iOS 12+)
nodes.rationale: STACK.md names Android/iOS as primary targets while ARCHITECTURE.md and CONVENTIONS.md describe desktop/tablet POS use cases with keyboard shortcuts — the target-platform story is inconsistent across planning docs.

nodes.label: Offline-First Non-Negotiable Constraint
nodes.rationale: 100% offline is treated as a hard constraint rather than a preference: no outbound network calls, no HTTP/Dio/HttpClient, no cloud SDKs, no analytics/telemetry/crash reporting, no remote config or update checkers. Any genuine need for network access must be called out and confirmed before wiring.

nodes.label: Banned Runtime-Fetching Packages
nodes.rationale: google_fonts, connectivity_plus, workmanager (for sync), and Firebase/Supabase clients are banned because they fetch resources or schedule sync at runtime; bundled assets/fonts/JetBrainsMono-*.ttf via fontFamily 'JetBrainsMono' replaces google_fonts.

nodes.label: Deleted Sync/Cloud-Backup Scaffolding (must not return)
nodes.rationale: The outbox queue, sync_service, sync_dao, connectivity_provider, and BackupService.uploadToCloud/restoreFromCloud were deliberately deleted and must never be reintroduced.

nodes.label: Platform Network Permission Lockdown
nodes.rationale: INTERNET must stay out of android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml and com.apple.security.network.* out of macos/Runner/Release.entitlements so the release binary is sandbox-blocked from the network at the OS level, not just by convention.

nodes.label: url_launcher Network-Adjacent Exception
nodes.rationale: url_launcher is allowed for user-initiated mailto:/tel:/sms:/https:// hand-offs because the native app makes the network request, not the POS binary.

nodes.label: graphify Knowledge Graph Workflow
nodes.rationale: graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md must be consulted before architecture questions, wiki/index.md preferred over raw files, and `graphify update .` run after code edits (AST-only, no API cost).

nodes.label: Core Mission (100% offline POS)
nodes.rationale: Provide a seamless POS experience that functions 100% offline, synchronizing only when necessary, with deep thermal-printer integration. The 'synchronize when necessary' clause predates the harder no-network rule in CLAUDE.md.

nodes.label: Guiding Principles (offline-first, hardware, feature-first, premium)
nodes.rationale: All transactional data must be persisted locally in Drift before any network operation; stable ESC/POS printing is non-negotiable; organize by business feature rather than by MVC layer.

nodes.label: Premium Glassmorphic Dark Aesthetic
nodes.rationale: A sleek dark-themed glassmorphic UI with vibrant curated palettes and HSL-tailored dark mode is meant to make the tool feel professional; v1_roadmap defers the Glassmorphic Theme itself to v2.

nodes.label: Riverpod as Sole DI Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Riverpod is the single dependency-injection and state-synchronization mechanism, so no service locator or second DI container is introduced.

nodes.label: Enforced Lint Rules (analysis_options)
nodes.rationale: always_use_package_imports and avoid_relative_lib_imports mechanically enforce the import convention; cancel_subscriptions/close_sinks guard the Drift stream + Riverpod listener model; avoid_print keeps stdout logging deliberate; unawaited_futures catches fire-and-forget DB writes.

nodes.label: custom_lint Analyzer Plugin (enabled in analysis_options)
nodes.rationale: The analyzer still declares the custom_lint plugin even though pubspec.yaml has custom_lint and riverpod_lint commented out pending analyzer ^7.x support — the plugin cannot actually load.

nodes.label: Generated-File Exclusion (*.g.dart, *.freezed.dart)
nodes.rationale: Generated drift and freezed output is excluded from analysis and invalid_annotation_target is downgraded to ignore to suppress freezed false positives.

nodes.label: pos_app Package Manifest (v1.0.0+9)
nodes.rationale: publish_to: none and the description 'single-user, works fully without internet' encode the offline, non-published nature of the app in the manifest itself.

nodes.label: flutter_thermal_printer dependency
nodes.rationale: The actual declared thermal-printer package (^0.0.9), paired with esc_pos_utils_plus, pdf and printing — not the heathen_printer_plus named throughout the planning docs.

nodes.label: Bundled JetBrainsMono Font Family
nodes.rationale: Regular/Bold/Italic/BoldItalic TTFs are bundled as assets so typography never requires a runtime font download, which is what makes banning google_fonts viable.

nodes.label: riverpod_generator Deliberately Omitted
nodes.rationale: Providers are written manually so no @riverpod annotation or generator is needed — directly contradicting CONVENTIONS.md, DEPENDENCIES.md and v1_roadmap.md, which all assume riverpod_generator is in use.
nodes.community_name: Riverpod Architecture Decision (provider type per concern)

nodes.label: custom_lint / riverpod_lint Commented Out
nodes.rationale: Disabled until custom_lint supports analyzer ^7.x; to be re-enabled afterwards.

nodes.label: Export & Sharing Stack (share_plus, csv, file_picker, permission_handler)
nodes.norm_label: export & sharing stack (share_plus, csv, file_picker, permission_handler)

nodes.label: Strict Phase Dependency Build Order
nodes.rationale: A phase cannot start until every item in the prior phase is shippable, which forces foundational correctness (schema, migrations, providers) before feature velocity.

nodes.label: Riverpod Architecture Decision (provider type per concern)
nodes.rationale: StreamProvider wraps Drift DAO watch queries so UI auto-rebuilds on row changes; AsyncNotifierProvider models checkout/sync loading-error-data; plain Provider holds global singletons at root so no service locator is needed; NotifierProvider with CartNotifier keeps cart state immutable in memory.
nodes.norm_label: riverpod architecture decision (provider type per concern)
nodes.community_name: Riverpod Architecture Decision (provider type per concern)

nodes.label: Provider Hierarchy / Boot Order
nodes.rationale: databaseProvider → hiveProvider → connectivityProvider → onboardingProvider → feature providers; every provider is overridable in tests via ProviderScope(overrides: [...]). The connectivityProvider link in this chain was later deleted per CLAUDE.md.
nodes.community_name: Riverpod Architecture Decision (provider type per concern)

nodes.label: v1 Phase 0 — Foundation (no UI)
nodes.rationale: Drift schemaVersion and migration strategy are wired from day 1 and all tables defined upfront, plus a startup SQLite PRAGMA + FK integrity check logged to the audit trail, because everything downstream depends on this being correct.

nodes.label: Connectivity Detection task (0.5, connectivity_plus)
nodes.rationale: Planned as a global online/offline state via connectivity_plus; CLAUDE.md later bans the package outright and records connectivity_provider as deleted.

nodes.label: outbox_queue table / offline outbox
nodes.rationale: Designed with endpoint, payload, retry_count and last_attempt_at columns to queue outbound deliveries (including Email/SMS receipts) until reconnect; CLAUDE.md lists the outbox queue as deleted scaffolding that must not return.

nodes.label: v1 Phase 1 — First-Run & Onboarding
nodes.rationale: No accounts and no login by design — data lives on-device only; a setup wizard sets the onboarding_complete flag and bundled locale JSON supplies country-based currency/tax defaults.

nodes.label: Tax Engine (multi-rate, inclusive/exclusive, per-product)
nodes.rationale: tax_rates carries inclusion_type and rounding_mode, products.is_taxable overrides the store default, and product_taxes joins products to rates; at checkout rates apply per line, build order_taxes rows, and print itemised tax lines per rate on every receipt.

nodes.label: v1 Phase 3 — Core Sales Loop
nodes.rationale: Voids are soft deletes behind a manager PIN and every sale/void/refund appends to an immutable audit log, so financial history is reconstructable without cloud storage.

nodes.label: v1 Phase 4 — Receipts & Hardware
nodes.rationale: Reprint re-renders ESC/POS from the stored order rather than caching a rendered blob; the cash drawer is kicked via ESC/POS DLE EOT through the printer port on cash payment.

nodes.label: v1 Phase 5 — Backup & Data Safety (local-only)
nodes.rationale: No cloud sync: backup is local-only via path_provider + share_plus, restore overwrites the local DB behind a confirmation dialog, history keeps the last 10 snapshots, and workmanager schedules a daily export — though CLAUDE.md bans workmanager for sync.

nodes.label: v1 Phase 7 — Customers, Loyalty & Audit
nodes.rationale: Customer lookup at POS uses SQLite FTS so search by name or phone stays instant offline during checkout.

nodes.label: v1 Phase 8 — Polish & Theme
nodes.rationale: Brand kit uses ColorScheme.fromSeed stored in Hive; a Minimal high-contrast flat theme targets bright retail environments; a preview screen shows a sample checkout before applying.

nodes.label: Append-Only Audit Log
nodes.rationale: One append-only table records every sale, void, refund, settings change and stock adjustment with old_value/new_value, giving an offline app its accountability layer in place of server-side history.

nodes.label: Drift Schema — Full v1 Table List
nodes.norm_label: drift schema — full v1 table list

nodes.label: Deferred to v2 (incl. Cloud Backup / Supabase Sync)
nodes.rationale: Cloud Backup / Supabase Sync is deferred explicitly because there are no accounts in v1; glassmorphic theme, price tiers, purchase orders, multi-location stock and CSV import are also pushed out to keep v1 shippable.
